title: Median of a list
spec: Return the median of a non-empty list of numbers. For an even count return the mean of the two middle values. The input list must not be modified.

candidates.summary: Incorrect: assumes the input is already sorted.
Incorrect: returns the upper middle value for even-length input.

evidence_notes: Both candidates are defective: c1 never sorts (core_behavior=false), c2 mishandles even counts (edge_cases=false).
